en.title: Backend Fundamentals Roadmap: What Stays When You Change Languages
en.subtitle: HTTP and API design, SQL and data modeling, indexes and transactions, caching and queues, security, logging, testing and deployment: six stages, one project to grow through them, and the books for each.
